independent_dsp56300.integration: Pinned independent DSP core for the regular Board/headless runtime. Explicit borrowed Memory and real external Io preserve native grants, callbacks, captured execution and clocks. Typed-memory API/alias/bounded component checks and one coherent Root SDK/USTB class rebuild with nine targeted native gates are qualified; see memory_api_integration. Earlier captured/bounded records pin historical sources. Complete native ISA, original full-instrument acceptance, realtime and remaining legacy test migration remain open.

release_integration.qualification: Historical Core46dc adoption before bounded/captured owner integration; unchanged headers and generic archive refer only to that baseline. Current captured execution evidence is recorded separately. No instrument-speed claim.

execution_integration.scope: Actual captured nonconditional owners after fully charged nonzero dependency delays; current canonical coupled consumers qualified; no new-ELF original boot or whole-instrument speed result

captured_core_integration.scope: Published Core API plus source-qualified 57 clocked-owner/197 prefix checks; current canonical13199 Timeline/43 MCU checks and standalone inspection. Original reset/playable instrument acceptance with the new ELF remains pending.

historical_bounded_owner.scope: Clocked bounded owners and preserved genuine staged fallbacks; no new original cold boot or instrument-throughput claim

memory_api_integration.scope: Coherent LLVM19 optimized Release SDK/USTB class rebuild; nine targeted native checks, including original USB reset/setup/probe/TCP and13199 timeline/43 MCU assertions. No new-Core original full boot, instrument-speed or physical-equivalence claim.

zlib.integration: Static upstream source build under the selected project dependency sanitizers; no system zlib fallback.

dsp56300.integration: Remaining legacy component tests only. The regular runtime uses independent_dsp56300; BUILD_TESTING=OFF with fuzzing disabled does not configure or build this dependency.

asmjit_host_cpuinfo.integration: Explicit std::call_once initialization; unchanged host detection operations and values. Required because the upstream build disables thread-safe local statics. Applied only by the existing build-copy patch.

accumulator_bus_growth.integration: Reference-only selected-source S growth uses S0-S1: high bits 46 normal, 47 down, 45 up. Sticky semantics and numeric transfers remain unchanged. The installed upstream checkout is untouched.

asmjit.integration: Required pinned submodule; configure verifies revision and tracked source cleanliness before copying and patching.

scalar_agu_compatibility.reference: DSP56300FM Rev5 section4.2 and Table5-1; doc/dsp-sc-moves.txt
scalar_agu_compatibility.integration: Build-copy-only native five-bit scalar R/N transfers under settled SC. Both native snapshot forms retain SC retirement history; unqualified transition sampling rejects. Other SC mode behavior remains separately scoped.

dsp56300_assembly_tool.usage: Optional offline assembler for own instruction expectations in original_dsp_download; not an emulator runtime dependency. Version1.0.0 expands forced-short BRA instructions and is not qualified for the documented SPI ROM prefix; use the separate pinned NXP reference tool.

pulseaudio.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (client); see upstream LICENSE for individual file notices
pulseaudio.integration: Upstream-generated client configuration and static native build under dependency sanitizers, with patches/pulseaudio-callback-types.patch correcting incompatible free callbacks. No system libpulse fallback.

libsndfile.integration: Static native dependency of the PulseAudio client. External codecs, programs, examples and upstream tests are disabled; native dependency sanitizers remain enabled.

meson.integration: Pinned Python build tool used only to configure unmodified PulseAudio source; no installation or system changes.

independent_cpu12.integration: Optional experimental build-time MCU executor. Keeps the existing board bus, cycles, reset/IRQ acknowledgement and coordinated CPU checkpoints. No SLEIGH execution fallback. Three focused native binding consumers and the late-RTI refill regression are qualified; complete native original boot and instrument/realtime acceptance remain pending. See native-mcu.txt.
